meta.siteDescription: A home for Japanese language, culture, and community in Norwalk, California. Japanese school, judo, basketball, cultural events, and more.

footer.legal: Southeast Japanese School & Community Center. A nonprofit community organization.
footer.farewellAccent: またお会いしましょう。

heroTabs.body: For 101 years, Saturdays here have meant Japanese school. The rest of the week: judo, hula, ukulele, and bingo — everyone is welcome.
Language, reading, and calligraphy from kindergarten through Level 12, with adult classes online. No Japanese background required.
Judo, kendo, basketball, hula, ukulele — the dojo, the gym, and the craft tables. Most groups welcome beginners year-round.
A volunteer-run nonprofit serving Japanese American families and neighbors in Norwalk since 1925.
Every gift sustains the school, the hall, and the festivals four generations call home.

history.body: From a small group of Japanese immigrant families in 1925 to a vibrant community today. We honor our heritage while building connections for the future.

milestones.text: Founded as Norwalk Gakuen, a Japanese language school for the local community.
Renamed Southeast Gakuen as the community grew.
Programs expand — cultural classes, sports, and activities for all ages.
Celebrating 101 years of learning, community, and belonging.

home.connectText: Everyone is welcome at SEJSCC. We are a nonprofit organization and all of our activities are open to anyone, regardless of race or religion. Together we learn, celebrate, volunteer, and create memories that last a lifetime.
